scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --workspace backend run dev" "npm --workspace frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace backend run build && npm --workspace frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace backend run test && npm --workspace frontend run test -- --run
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --workspace backend run start" "npm --workspace frontend run preview -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4173"
